messages.text: Hello, my name is Edoardo. I am a young Italian chef currently working full-time in Brisbane, and I am here in Australia with my girlfriend, Sara. We are both employed and are looking for a room in a house in the city. We are very clean and tidy people, and we appreciate a calm and peaceful environment.
